sources.author: Epic Games
sources.title: Text Localization
locations: Opening text history and conversion discussion
claims: FText history supports culture-correct rebuilding; ordinary FString conversion loses that history.
Namespace and Key identify localizable text literals.
Text Value Marshalling is a separate information-preserving representation, not ordinary displayed-string conversion.
limits: No complete marshalling API/compatibility tutorial or restricted-source inspection.
No claim that every string representation loses localization information.

sources.author: Epic Games
sources.title: FText
claims: ToString does not carry localization data; FromString does not reconstruct original localization data.
Non-editor FromString matches AsCultureInvariant; in editor it is not flagged invariant and may become localizable through saved-asset FText properties.
Intentional invariant display of an external player name is a supported use case.
limits: Later localizability does not prove recovery of the original text identity.
No guarantee of every custom widget updating.

sources.author: Epic Games
sources.title: Managing the Active Culture at Runtime
claims: Language chooses localization data; locale controls numeric/date/time formatting.
PIE/UMG localization previews load localization data without changing language/locale settings; standalone is recommended for runtime representation.
limits: Standalone launched from the Editor is not automatically a non-editor build.
No project culture settings, translation packaging or load success verified.

original_scenario.execution: Unexecuted contrast plan, no engine compilation or runtime.
original_scenario.setup: One prompt with two already-available translations and a working retained-FText baseline. The data-layer FString snapshot outlives the panel and is not refreshed on reopen.
cases: A retains original FText with resource/widget conditions.
B wraps the same old display snapshot with FromString; no original identity restoration.
C uses fictional invariant player name Rin_42, intentionally unchanged.
limits: Snapshot is a FString variable name, not the FTextSnapshot helper type.
No measured UI behavior, performance or human outcome.
If A also fails, investigate language/resources/widget updates before assigning the cause to conversion.

reader_review_corrections: Made PIE/UMG preview non-change of language/locale explicit.
Separated Snapshot variable from FTextSnapshot type.
